name: Seated dumbbell overhead press
definition: Sit against an upright bench with a dumbbell at each shoulder. Press both dumbbells upward and return them to shoulder height.

catalogue_anchor.notes: Original broad muscle labels retained separately; not silently promoted to accepted anatomy.

value.start: Sit against an upright bench with a dumbbell at each shoulder.
value.movement: Press both dumbbells upward and return them to shoulder height.
value.finish: Finish in the same supported seated position.
value.range_of_motion: Shoulder-to-overhead hand travel; record bench angle and grip.
